definitions.explanation: Activities, study, or events that take place outside of regular class hours or the standard curriculum.

examples.japanese: {課外|かがい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{課外|かがい}⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an extracurricular class after school.

examples.japanese: {課外|かがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧、⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んでいる→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: Through extracurricular learning, the students are gaining social experience.

notes:
Almost always used as a modifier before another noun, functioning like a prefix meaning "outside the regular curriculum." Composed of ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ (lesson/curriculum) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). Rarely used as a standalone noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {課外|かがい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: extracurricular activities
- {課外|かがい}⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: extracurricular lessons; supplementary classes
- {課外|かがい}⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧: extracurricular learning/study
- {課外|かがい}⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧: extracurricular course
- {課外|かがい}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: extracurricular research

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧: club activities — the most common term for after-school club activities at Japanese schools
- ⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧: after school — refers to the time period after classes end, not the activities themselves
- ⟦{校外|こうがい}→校外：24139_kougai⟧: off-campus; outside school — refers to physical location outside the school grounds, while {課外|かがい} refers to being outside the curriculum
